meta.title: SAID IN KOREAN · Learn Korean online
meta.description: Learn Korean online with General Korean A1–C2 and TOPIK preparation courses, an optional level quiz, coaching and Speaking Chat.

home.title: Learn Korean with online courses
home.lede: Choose General Korean or TOPIK preparation. New learners can start with a free alphabet course; the level quiz is optional.

paths.title: Choose your learning path
paths.lede: Choose a General Korean or TOPIK course directly. Paid lessons are available for six months after purchase; the level quiz is optional.

general.title: General Korean
general.meta: Six courses · 15 lessons of 40 minutes each

topik.title: TOPIK preparation
topik.meta: Six separate courses · 10 lessons of 50 minutes each

quiz.title: Not sure where to start?
quiz.body: Check reading, listening and writing across six levels.

alphabet.title: Start with the Korean alphabet
alphabet.body: A free video lesson, alphabet reference and practice quiz for everyone. Materials in English and German are being prepared.

services.title: Learn with the teacher
services.lede: Coaching supports an active purchased course. Speaking Chat is a separate conversation service.

coaching.title: Course coaching
coaching.body: For an active purchased course. Sold separately.

chat.title: Speaking Chat
chat.body: A 50-minute informal conversation. No course purchase needed.

teacher.title: Meet the teacher
teacher.body: Verified biography and qualifications will appear after approval. Contact email is being created.
